baseline_models.mechanism: A deliberate lean is assigned wholly to God: ghayr excludes an added share, while the repeated shirk construction names the prohibited division of worship.

activation_trace.role: The branch image of leaning toward a direction supplies active reorientation and functions as the posture governing the clause.
The worship-and-worshiped branch supplies the relation's divine endpoint and makes the lean an act of devotion rather than geometry.
The exclusion and negation branch supplies the boundary around the posture and functions to bar a contrary identity.
The ordinary sharing branch supplies division of one matter among claimants and functions as the relational mechanics behind association.
The God-association branch supplies the explicit cultic scope and confines the prohibited sharing to the divine relation.

changed_reading.before: Be sincere monotheists and do not associate partners with God.
changed_reading.after: Maintain a directional posture whose motion and worship terminate wholly in God, with no second claimant admitted into that relation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: خَرَّ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ فَتَخْطَفُهُ الطَّيْرُ أَوْ تَهْوِي بِهِ الرِّيحُ فِي مَكَانٍ سَحِيقٍ
baseline_models.mechanism: The simile removes stable position and then divides the victim between two uncontrolled trajectories: rapid seizure by mobile creatures or wind-driven descent into remoteness.

activation_trace.role: The disturbed, sounding fall supplies the initial loss of support and functions as the irreversible transition into exposure.
The sky-as-overarching-height branch supplies the elevated origin and functions as the support zone from which the subject is severed.
The light, rapid seizure branch supplies abrupt dispossession and functions as one route by which the falling subject loses bodily integrity and agency.
The light flight branch supplies mobile airborne takers and functions as the multiplying agents of seizure.
The plunge toward an abyss branch supplies the second downward trajectory and functions as uncontrolled transport toward an endpoint.
The blowing-wind branch supplies an impersonal carrier and functions as force without a destination chosen by the carried subject.
The place and station branch supplies a terminal location and functions as the anti-station produced by displacement.
The distance and banishment branch supplies extreme remoteness and functions as the completed loss of relation to the starting center.

changed_reading.before: Association is compared to a fatal fall from the sky.
changed_reading.after: Association is modeled as loss of a holding center: position, agency, bodily coherence, and destination successively pass to competing external forces.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يُشْرِكْ ... فَتَخْطَفُهُ ... أَوْ تَهْوِي بِهِ الرِّيحُ
baseline_models.mechanism: Form-distant branches permit an interior analogue: divided counsel removes the mind's single center, desire hollows direction, and a stronger current carries what rapid capture has not already taken.

activation_trace.role: The non-unitary or shared opinion branch supplies divided counsel and functions as the mental form of association.
The capture of reason branch supplies sudden cognitive dispossession and functions as the interior counterpart of avian seizure.
The empty air and hollow heart branch supplies loss of inner stability and functions as the medium through which the self is carried.
The inclination of desire branch supplies self-directed appetite and functions as a live alternative driver of the plunge.
The wind-as-force branch supplies overpowering momentum and functions as the dominance that replaces deliberate orientation.

changed_reading.before: The image describes external bodily destruction.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also diagrams cognitive and volitional dispersal: divided allegiance makes reason capturable and leaves desire or ambient force to choose the destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: The worshiper on an edge settles only under benefit and reverses on his face under trial. That sequence distinguishes the Godward lean of hunafa from a conditional tilt poised to flip direction.

activation_trace.role: The directed lean supplies the focus posture and functions as the stable orientation being differentiated.
The branch image of inclining away from a direction supplies edge-instability and functions as the false counterpart to the Godward lean.
The turning of a thing from its face supplies reversal and functions as the transition from conditional worship to loss.
The direction and orientation branch supplies the face as vector and functions as the visible indicator that the worshiper's course has inverted.

structural_cues: 22:11 orders benefit, settling, trial, face-reversal, and loss as a conditional instability sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies edge, directional face, and reversal; I infer that conditional attachment is the arrow converting a lean into a fall. A live alternative is that 22:11 supplies a parallel apostasy scene without directly specifying hunafa.

changed_reading.before: Hunafa means simply turning toward God rather than partners.
changed_reading.after: Hunafa is a load-bearing orientation that survives changed conditions; shirk begins when the apparent lean remains an edge-balance capable of reversing with circumstance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah, cosmic and ritual bodies lower themselves in coordinated devotion. The focus fall becomes an inverted lowering: refusal of single devotion does not prevent descent, but changes ordered prostration into uncontrolled collapse.

activation_trace.role: The fall branch, whose scope includes falling in prostration, supplies the ambiguous lowering and functions as the hinge between devotion and collapse.
The lowering and abasement branch supplies creation-wide submission and functions as the ordered cosmic alternative to the focus fall.
The bending and head-lowering branch supplies deliberate ritual descent and functions as a controlled bodily trajectory.
The lowering branch supplies prostration at the purified House and functions as descent organized around a center.
The commanded bend supplies chosen lowering and functions as the closing bodily answer to the earlier uncontrolled fall.
The commanded prostration supplies the surah's final ordered descent and functions as the route to preserved orientation.

structural_cues: 22:18 universalizes prostration; 22:26 locates bowing and prostration at the House; 22:77 repeats both as closing commands.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated chosen lowering and a fall branch that includes prostration; I infer an anti-prostration reversal in the simile. The materially live alternative is a purely punitive fall with no parodic relation to sujud.

changed_reading.before: The associator is punished by falling.
changed_reading.after: Every body lowers somehow: Godward lowering is centered, deliberate, and repeatable, while divided devotion converts the same vertical grammar into centerless collapse.

context_deltas.mechanism: God holds the sky from falling, while the focus subject falls from that sky; the closing command to hold fast to God supplies the relational counterpart. Association is thus loss of the one hold that keeps a trajectory coherent.

activation_trace.role: The disturbed fall supplies the exposed subject and functions as the result whose missing restraint the context reveals.
The grasping and restraining branch supplies active preservation and functions as the counterforce to falling.
The overarching sky branch repeats the focus medium and functions as the exact object whose stability depends on divine holding.
The falling-and-settling branch supplies the prevented event and functions as the explicit inverse of the subject's fall.
The hold that prevents and preserves supplies relational attachment and functions as the human-side answer to divine restraint.

structural_cues: 22:65 makes sky-fall a divinely restrained possibility; 22:78 closes with holding fast to God and names Him patron and helper.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine restraint, prevented sky-fall, and commanded holding; I infer a two-sided holding relation whose abandonment exposes the focus subject. Alternatively, 22:65 may remain cosmological care rather than a direct model of shirk.

changed_reading.before: The person happens to fall from a high place.
changed_reading.after: The person falls out of a preserved relation: substitutes divide allegiance but cannot provide the single hold that keeps sky, self, and destination coherent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later fly simile miniaturizes the focus seizure: what is invoked besides God cannot retrieve even what a fly steals. The associator entrusts the self to claimants that cannot reverse the smallest airborne dispossession.

activation_trace.role: The light, rapid seizure branch supplies the focus dispossession and functions as the action mirrored at smaller scale.
The light airborne creature branch supplies the focus taker and functions as the large-scale counterpart to the fly.
The fly branch supplies the tiny airborne thief and functions as a scale-reversing test of the invoked powers.
The extraction-from-another's-grasp branch supplies rescue as the failed operation and functions as the missing reversal of seizure.
The weakness branch supplies incapacity in both seeker and sought and functions as the explanation for irretrievability.

structural_cues: 22:73 says the fly robs something from the invoked beings, they cannot recover it, and both seeker and sought are weak; the branchless س ل ب occurrence is used only as this structural cue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies airborne theft, failed recovery, and reciprocal weakness; I infer that 22:73 exposes why no partner can rescue the snatched self of 22:31. An alternative is simple reuse of seizure imagery without identity between the two similes.

changed_reading.before: Birds are merely frightening agents in a punishment image.
changed_reading.after: The airborne seizure also tests alleged power: those invoked besides God cannot recover even a fly's spoil, much less reassemble or redirect the person surrendered to divided allegiance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah relocates blindness to hearts, describes a distant split, and answers it with humbled hearts guided to a straight path. These cues stabilize the focus branches of captured reason and hollow desire as an interior fall.

activation_trace.role: The capture-of-reason branch supplies cognitive loss and functions as the focus anchor for the interior model.
The hollow heart and empty air branch supplies inner vacancy and functions as the medium of cognitive falling.
The heart branch supplies the faculty at issue and functions as the actual site of perception or blindness.
The reason that restrains ignorance supplies cognitive binding and functions as the coherence lost when reason is snatched.
The blindness of heart and insight branch supplies nonvisual blindness and functions as evidence that the fall can be epistemic.
The splitting of a group by disagreement supplies social-cognitive division and functions as the collective form of a divided center.
The distant tract branch supplies remoteness inside schism and functions as a verbal bridge to the focus endpoint.
The gentle direction toward the true road supplies restored guidance and functions as the counteraction to cognitive capture.
The straight road branch supplies coherent trajectory and functions as the alternative to wind-driven remoteness.

structural_cues: 22:46 contrasts seeing eyes with blind hearts; 22:53 moves from diseased or hard hearts to distant schism; 22:54 moves from recognition to faith, humbled hearts, and a straight path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies heart-blindness, reason as restraint, distant schism, and restored guidance; I infer that the physical sequence externalizes an interior loss of integration. The alternative is that these are parallel moral consequences rather than the mechanism of the simile.

changed_reading.before: The fall concerns bodily exposure to birds and wind.
changed_reading.after: The fall can also stage the unbinding of reason: a blind or hollow heart divides into distant schism until external currents, rather than restrained insight, determine its path.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah places one God beside multiple communities and rites, and presents night and day entering one another under God's action. Multiplicity and interrelation are therefore not themselves shirk; the prohibited share is elevation of another into God's unique divine claim.

activation_trace.role: The ordinary sharing branch supplies the broad relational possibility and functions as the reading that context must delimit.
The association-with-God branch supplies the narrower cultic violation and functions as the contextually selected scope.
The community-or-kind branch supplies legitimate human plurality and functions as the distributed subject of ritual.
The place and performance of rite branch supplies differentiated ritual forms and functions as plurality ordered toward one deity.
The branch of God's oneness without partner supplies the non-shareable center and functions as the limit on ritual plurality.
The entering of one thing into another supplies divinely governed interpenetration and functions as evidence that overlap need not be rivalry.
The repeated community branch supplies continuing plurality and functions as the social container for distinct rites.
The repeated rite branch supplies practiced ritual difference and functions as a non-idolatrous multiplicity explicitly made by God.

structural_cues: 22:34 moves from a rite for every community to 'your deity is one deity'; 22:67 again assigns each community a rite; 22:61 attributes mutual night-day entry to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one deity, many communities and rites, and governed interpenetration; I infer a scope restriction from generic sharing to rival divine entitlement. A live alternative is that the cosmological overlap of 22:61 is unrelated to the semantic boundary of shirk.

changed_reading.before: Non-association can sound like rejection of every shared, plural, or overlapping relation.
changed_reading.after: The ayah rejects rival divinity, not coordinated plurality: communities, rites, and interpenetrating created processes remain many while their source and divine endpoint remain one.

context_deltas.mechanism: A consecrated animal falls, becomes shared food, and does not bodily reach God; taqwa reaches Him. In the focus counterimage, misdirected dedication makes the dedicator fall and become airborne prey rather than a participant in ordered distribution.

activation_trace.role: The bodily fall supplies the focus descent and functions as the point compared with the consecrated animal's fall.
The rapid taking branch supplies predatory removal and functions as the disordered alternative to commanded eating and feeding.
The falling-and-occurring branch supplies the sacrificial body's fall and functions as a ritually contained counterpart to kharra.
The eating branch supplies authorized consumption and functions as one ordered destination for the fallen body's matter.
The feeding-another branch supplies social redistribution and functions as the opposite of seizure by competing takers.
The reaching and attaining branch supplies the denied bodily ascent and the affirmed attainment of taqwa, functioning as the vertical correction.
The protection-from-harm branch supplies taqwa's protective orientation and functions as what reaches God instead of flesh or blood.

structural_cues: 22:36 orders the fallen sacrificial body into eating and feeding; 22:37 denies that flesh or blood reaches God and affirms that taqwa does.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two bodily falls, predatory taking versus social distribution, and a correction of what reaches God; I infer an anti-sacrificial reversal in which false dedication makes the worshiper prey. The alternative is a vivid but accidental juxtaposition of independent ritual and warning images.

changed_reading.before: The focus victim is simply destroyed by animals or wind.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the victim becomes an anti-offering: correct dedication distributes a fallen body while taqwa rises, but divided dedication turns the dedicator into prey and sends the person, rather than piety, away.

context_deltas.mechanism: Deep routes can converge on the House, and all affairs return to God; mere distance is therefore not failure. The focus remote place is a pathologically centerless endpoint, sharpened by the surah's 'distant schism.'

activation_trace.role: The place and station branch supplies the terminal location and functions as the endpoint whose relation to a center is being tested.
The distance and banishment branch supplies remoteness and functions as failed arrival rather than neutral mileage.
The deep or distant road branch supplies great travel distance and functions as a successful convergent route toward the House.
The distant tract branch supplies remoteness within schism and functions as the moral-spatial analogue of the focus endpoint.
The return-to-what-was branch supplies universal return and functions as the convergent trajectory against which remote displacement is read.

structural_cues: 22:27 brings pilgrims from every deep pass toward a named center; 22:53 locates wrongdoers in distant schism; 22:76 says all affairs are returned to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deep but convergent travel, distant schism, and universal return; I infer that sahiq marks broken orientation rather than distance alone. The alternative is that the passages share only spatial vocabulary while the focus remains literal remoteness.

changed_reading.before: Sahiq intensifies the physical distance of the landing place.
changed_reading.after: Sahiq names nonreturning distance: a deep road remains viable when it has a center, whereas shirk produces remoteness whose trajectory no longer participates in conscious return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening quake destabilizes the shared world, while a later ruined village is destroyed and collapsed on its structures. The focus fall compresses that surah-wide collapse pattern into one exposed person.

activation_trace.role: The disturbed fall supplies personal collapse and functions as the small-scale instance of a larger destabilization pattern.
The disturbance and shaking branch supplies world-scale loss of stability and functions as the surah's opening scale for the focus fall.
The fall into destruction branch supplies communal extinction and functions as the historical-scale counterpart to the exposed individual.
The collapse and demolition branch supplies structures fallen upon themselves and functions as built-form disintegration parallel to bodily disintegration.

structural_cues: The whole-surah sequence opens with universal shaking, places the individual fall at 22:31, and later displays a village collapsed upon its roofs at 22:45.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies collapse at cosmic, personal, and civic scales; I infer a scale-recursive mechanism in which loss of right relation destabilizes an integrated whole. The alternative is thematic recurrence without a shared causal model.

changed_reading.before: The focus simile is an isolated image of one person's punishment.
changed_reading.after: The person becomes a miniature ruined world: the same loss of integration that shakes a cosmos and hollows a settlement is rendered as one body losing support, unity, and place.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the foot-deformity branch of hanif rather than its familiar directional branch. It remains anchored in حُنَفَاءَ and gains local support from the immediately preceding pilgrimage by foot, on lean mounts, through open passes; downstream prose should present it only as an embodied branch-image overlay, not as the lexical replacement for hunafa.

activation_trace.role: The bent or turned foot branch supplies bodily asymmetry and functions as an image of orientation enacted through gait.
The intent toward what is magnified branch supplies pilgrimage as purposeful approach and functions as the gait's destination.
The walking-on-legs branch supplies pedestrian movement and functions as the immediate embodied cue for the foot image.
The gathered lightness after preparation branch supplies lean mounts shaped by travel and functions as a second non-idealized pilgrimage body.
The open pass between mountains supplies a traversable channel and functions as the terrain through which directed gait converges.

changed_reading.before: Hunafa is an abstract doctrinal orientation.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, hunafa becomes a pilgrim gait: even a bent foot, lean body, or distant route can enact wholeness when every uneven step converges on God.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because السماء is plainly the sky in the focus while the activated branch concerns name and designation. It remains root-anchored through س م و and is repeatedly cued by 'the name of God' and 'He named you the submitters'; downstream prose should label it a form-distant lexical resonance, never a replacement of the physical sky.

activation_trace.role: The name-as-notice-and-indication branch supplies recognized designation and functions as a secondary resonance inside the surface sky.
The name branch is realized in God's name and functions as the first repeated naming cue around the focus.
The repeated name branch supplies ritual designation and functions as a God-centered identity marker across communities.
The name branch supplies consecrating speech over the sacrificial animals and functions as the verbal alignment of matter with God.
The name branch supplies public remembrance in protected worship places and functions as socially maintained recognition.
The naming branch supplies the designation 'submitters' and functions as the closing communal identity cue.

changed_reading.before: The associator falls physically from the sky.
changed_reading.after: As a contained resonance, the associator also falls out of God-centered naming and recognizable submission, moving from a shared designation into remote anonymity.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the birds and wind as a lesson in secondary causation rather than only as threats. It remains anchored in the grammatical agents of تَخْطَفُهُ الطَّيْرُ and تَهْوِي بِهِ الرِّيحُ and in يُشْرِكْ بِاللَّهِ, while the context supplies subjugated processes and selected messengers; downstream prose should state only that agency need not imply divinity, not that the birds or wind are messengers.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يُشْرِكْ بِاللَّهِ ... تَخْطَفُهُ الطَّيْرُ ... تَهْوِي بِهِ الرِّيحُ

activation_trace.role: The association-with-God branch supplies the forbidden promotion and functions as the distinction that secondary agency must not cross.
The flying-creature branch supplies a real grammatical actor and functions as an example of effective but nondivine agency.
The blowing-wind branch supplies an impersonal effective force and functions as a second created agent.
The subjection and steering branch supplies created processes directed to a purpose and functions as the sovereignty frame for secondary action.
The affair or directive branch supplies action under God's command and functions as the ordering source behind effective means.
The selection of a chosen representative supplies delegated agency and functions as evidence that mediation need not divide divinity.
The messenger and message branch supplies authorized mediation and functions as the clearest contextual distinction between agent and partner.

changed_reading.before: The active birds and wind can sound like autonomous rival powers in the simile.
changed_reading.after: Their efficacy does not make them partners: the simile can preserve real created agency while reserving sovereignty and divinity for God alone.

strongest_changes: The Godward lean is distinguished from edge-worship that reverses under trial.
The fall is recast as inverted prostration: lowering is inevitable, but only God-centered lowering remains ordered.
God's holding of the sky and the command to hold fast expose missing restraint as the core of the fall.
The fly simile explains the irretrievability of the snatched subject by showing the weakness of every invoked substitute.
Legitimate communal and ritual plurality narrows shirk to rival divine entitlement rather than multiplicity itself.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context repeatedly reversed the focus image rather than merely echoing it: stable leaning opposed edge-reversal, prostration opposed collapse, holding opposed falling, feeding opposed predation, convergent depth opposed remote nonreturn, and a tiny fly exposed the impotence of alleged partners. Form-distant branches also preserved two contained activations that conservative synthesis would likely lose: the pilgrim gait of hanif and the naming resonance inside sama.
remaining_uncertainties: The anti-prostration reading depends on treating the prostration scope of خ ر ر as active in this explicitly spatial fall.
The cognitive model relies on form-distant branches of خ ط ف and ه و ي and may be analogy rather than mechanism.
The anti-sacrificial reversal is structurally close to the focus but remains an inferred comparison, not an explicit equation.
The sky-as-naming and bent-foot pilgrimage readings should remain marked lexical resonances rather than surface translations.
